quotes.text: The issue isn't that the information doesn't exist. It's every system clings to its own view of the truth like it's the only source that matters.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Names the real cause of reporting pain: competing systems of truth, not missing data.

quotes.text: Rather than needing your IT staff to handcraft every query, the system interprets natural questions and generates the data actions beneath the surface.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains in one sentence how Copilot with Fabric data agents turns natural language into queries.

quotes.text: Rather than every system trying to talk directly with every other, they all meet in the same place. That central hub becomes what your copilot can query.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A clear architectural picture of hub-based integration through Fabric connectors.

quotes.text: It shifts the heavy lifting from custom engineering into a setup task that feels more like assigning permissions than coding an application.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Captures how pre-built connectors change the economics of data integration.

quotes.text: It's only when you have integrated data sets that patterns emerge, Trends that fall between the cracks when each department stays isolated.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Argues why cross-system data is the prerequisite for useful predictions.

takeaways: Scattered CRM, ERP and database silos cost time and trust because every system insists on its own version of the truth.
Fabric connectors bring systems like Dynamics 365, SAP, Salesforce and SQL into one hub that Copilot with Fabric data agents can query in plain language.
Once data is unified, the same setup moves teams from backward-looking KPIs to predictive insights they can act on in real time.
hook: Your CRM, ERP and databases hold the answers, but combining them still takes exports, spreadsheets and weeks of waiting. This episode is for business and data leaders who want one AI chatbot that answers cross-system questions instantly. You will learn how Fabric connectors and Copilot with Fabric data agents unify your data and turn it into real-time, predictive insight.
